hero.subheadline: Crafting unforgettable stays through genuine hospitality, personalized service, and curated experiences

brandStory.heading: It Was Never About the Room
brandStory.quote: It's the sound of rain on a clay roof, the warmth of a stranger who becomes a friend, the stillness of a hillside at dawn.
brandStory.body: We don't design stays around amenities — we design them around moments. A cup of tea handed to you at exactly the right time. A quiet path only the staff know about. The kind of hospitality that isn't performed, but felt.

testimonials.heading: Stories From Those Who Stayed
testimonials.subheading: Every stay is shaped by thoughtful hospitality, genuine care, and unforgettable moments. Discover what our guests have shared about their Raksha & Ridge experience.

lindqvist.quote: From the moment we arrived, it felt less like a hotel stay and more like being welcomed into someone's home — every detail considered, nothing overdone.
lindqvist.name: Amara & Josef Lindqvist

nair.quote: We've stayed at properties across Southeast Asia, but the warmth here was different. Genuinely personal, never performative.
nair.name: Priya Nair

reid.quote: The staff remembered things we hadn't even mentioned twice. That kind of attentiveness is rare, and it made the entire trip feel effortless.
reid.name: Thomas Reid

earlySeasonEscape.title: Early Season Escape

extendedCoastalStay.title: Extended Coastal Stay
extendedCoastalStay.description: Five nights or more by the coast, with a morning at sea included for every stay.

consulting.heading: Advisory Services for Independent Hospitality Owners
consulting.body: We partner with property owners across Sri Lanka to bring the same standard of hospitality to their own operations — from brand positioning to guest experience design.
